features.name: Unified table storage for extensions
features.description: Business Central 29 introduces a major change where fields from table extensions are stored in the same database table as the base table, replacing the previous extension companion table model.
features.status_evidence_quote: business 29 is currently in public preview. The platform behavior in Microsoft documentation may change before general availability.
caveats: Developers should treat physical SQL schema as implementation detail

features.name: Cross-field indexes spanning base and extension tables
features.description: Developers can now define indexes that span fields from both a base table and its extension tables, which was not possible under the previous companion table model due to SQL storage constraints.
features.status_evidence_quote: business 29 is currently in public preview. The platform behavior in Microsoft documentation may change before general availability.
caveats: Limitation previously existed in prior two models

features.name: Improved database operation performance for extensions
features.description: Database operations involving table extensions can benefit from faster data loading because all fields are now stored in a single table instead of requiring joins across companion tables. Get, find and other operations fetch from one table instead of multiple.
caveats: Performance gains dependent on query complexity
Applies specifically to extension field access
Requires proper use of partial load and other optimization parameters

features.name: Partial record loading with set load field
features.description: Developers should continue using set load field (partial loading) even with version 29. Instead of fetching all fields from SQL server, specify only needed fields to reduce query size and execution time.
caveats: Underlying model changes do not eliminate the need

features.name: Compiler warnings for table column limit
features.description: Business Central 29 introduces compiler warnings when tables or table extensions with many normal fields approach SQL column limits. Helps developers identify data models reaching SQL extension limits.
features.status_evidence_quote: business 29 is currently in public preview. The platform behavior in Microsoft documentation may change before general availability.
caveats: Behavior on different field types unclear
Unclear if applies to base tables and extension tables equally
Behavior when limit is exceeded not specified
